description: Defines the TaskLocation trait and its implementations for different task placement scenarios in Spark scheduler, including host, executor, and HDFS cache locations.

classes.name: ExecutorCacheTaskLocation
classes.description: Represents a task location on a specific host and executor.

classes.name: HostTaskLocation
classes.description: Represents a task location on a host.

classes.name: HDFSCacheTaskLocation
classes.description: Represents a task location cached by HDFS on a host.

methods.name: apply(host: String, executorId: String)
methods.description: Creates an ExecutorCacheTaskLocation with specified host and executor ID.

methods.name: apply(str: String)
methods.description: Creates a TaskLocation object from a string representation, parsing for cache, executor, or host location.
